entries.title: Fixed Open Ladder Frame Pedal Kart
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed open pedal-kart exterior. A low full ladder chassis carries four thick annular tires with finite bottom tread facets and distinct hubs, a whole rear axle on two bearings, and two front kingpin carriers with separate stub axles and a real transverse steering tie link. A full inclined column joins a three-spoke open steering ring. An independent pedal shaft has two opposed fixed cranks and whole tread pedals; one closed thick chain-band appearance joins two fixed sprocket discs beside the low seat. The seat pan, inclined back and risers are rooted on the chassis. This is not an old bumper-car shell stripped away or a bicycle given extra wheels: all low chassis, independent front carriers, rear axle and low-seated pedal layout are newly authored together; no old mesh imports. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal ground centering. One model and zero scenes. Empty fixed art only: no functioning steering or differential, chain travel, gear teeth engagement, brakes, drive performance, racing or road use, rider fit, load, engineering, fabrication or safety claim.
